tooltips.taylor-swift: Her country debut with autobiographical lyrics about teenage love and small-town life.
tooltips.fearless: Modern fairy tales that catapulted her to stardom. Radiant optimism and dreamy romance.
tooltips.speak-now: Entirely self-written. Epic stories of love, regret, and redemption.
tooltips.red: Intense emotions and transition from country to pop. Burning passion and self-discovery.
tooltips.1989: Total reinvention with synth-pop inspired by the 80s. A new pop identity.
tooltips.reputation: Dark era with electronic beats and sharp lyrics about fame and reinvention.
tooltips.lover: Celebration of love in all its forms. Joyful, colorful, and romantic.
tooltips.folklore: Introspective indie-folk narrative with fictional tales, nature, and nostalgia.
tooltips.evermore: Autumnal continuation of folklore with melancholic and mature stories.
tooltips.midnights: Nocturnal reflections on dark thoughts, dreams, and anxieties.
